payload.title: Approved posts as examples when drafting (#22)
payload.objective: Send the texts a member approved as examples with each draft request, so drafts keep the voice, pick up edits and stop repeating themselves. Brought forward from M6 without metrics.
successCriteria: The last few approved texts of the same channel are sent; the number is a setting and zero turns it off
Rejected and unapproved drafts are never used
The plan pages and settings say what is sent and the cost estimate includes it
ADR 0011 and the README are updated
